## Roboto — letter outlines in the logo

The InkToday logo (`inktoday/logo.svg`, `inktoday/icon*.bmp`) contains the outlines of the letters
"Ink" and "Today" taken from Roboto (Copyright 2011 The Roboto Project Authors), licensed under the
SIL Open Font License 1.1, https://openfontlicense.org. The font itself is not included.
